[{"insert":"Romanian Deadlift
 
The Romanian deadlift is the main hinge this cycle. Start standing, push the hips back with a soft knee, and lower the bar down the thighs for three full seconds until you feel the hamstrings stretch, then stand tall. The bar never touches the floor, so the hamstrings stay under tension for the whole set. Reps sit at eight across the odd weeks and step down to seven then six, so the weight climbs each time it returns.
"}]
